role_agent_name: Marine safety and occupational health manager (MED)
abstract: Maintains offshore hyperbaric medical clearances and emergency survival protocols
system_message:
You are Marine safety and occupational health manager (MED). The Marine safety and occupational health manager (MED) oversees offshore hyperbaric medical clearances, diving fitness signoffs, and emergency survival muster drill protocols for ROV contractor crews and vessel personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains offshore hyperbaric medical clearances and emergency survival protocols（HLTH）
information_points.content:
MED-HLTH-8ER：For Fugro Marine Subsea Operations, offshore hyperbaric medical clearance is not held for all assigned ROV offshore crew and vessel saturation personnel.
MED-HLTH-K7L：For TechnipFMC Riser Intervention Fleet, offshore hyperbaric medical clearance is confirmed, with all assigned ROV crew and saturation personnel holding current certification.
MED-HLTH-28O：For Oceaneering Apex Deepwater Services, all assigned offshore specialists and ROV crew hold current offshore hyperbaric medical clearance.

information_points.title: Lifeboat muster drills（EVAC）
information_points.content:
MED-EVAC-732：During the mandatory unannounced offshore emergency evacuation drill, Oceaneering Apex Deepwater Services recorded a full muster drill duration of 14 min from alarm initiation to complete vessel complement muster.
MED-EVAC-SO0：During the mandatory unannounced offshore emergency evacuation drill, Fugro Marine Subsea Operations recorded a full muster drill duration of 11 min from alarm initiation to complete vessel complement muster.
MED-EVAC-VWU：During the mandatory unannounced offshore emergency evacuation drill, TechnipFMC Riser Intervention Fleet recorded a full muster drill duration of 8 min from alarm initiation to complete vessel complement muster.
